text: ひっくりかえる　くらい　しょうぶに　かち　まくっちゃって　つっ　つよすぎだなあー　きみ！

structure.jp: ひっくりかえる　くらい
structure.en: enough to make me fall over

structure.jp: しょうぶに　かち　まくっちゃって
structure.en: you've gone and won battle after battle

structure.jp: つっ　つよすぎだなあー　きみ！

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.span: ひっくりかえる　くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a verb says 'to the point of', showing how far something goes. ひっくりかえる くらい = 'so much that I could fall over'.

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.span: かち　まくっちゃって
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto a verb says it is done again and again without holding back. かち まくっちゃって = 'winning over and over'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short spoken form of てしまう, which says something has gone and happened completely. まくっちゃって = 'you've gone and done it like crazy'.
